lines.text: Count out from the Sun. Fly to the seventh planet!
Fly to the planet farthest from the Sun!
Mystery planet! I spin tipped over on my side. I am an ice giant, and I look blue-green. Who am I?
Read the strip. About how far is Jupiter from the Sun?
Tap the star colors from hottest to coolest.
What keeps the Moon going around Earth?
Which is smaller, Mercury or Saturn?
Why does the Sun look so much bigger than the other stars?
You jump 1 foot high on Earth. About how high on Mars?
